text: ① 全天 韩国股市休市，中国台湾股市休市； ② 可能发布 中国1-9月社会融资规模增量、新增人民币贷款，9月M2等货币供应； ③ 18:15 欧洲央行执委Cipollone讲话； ④ 20:30 加拿大9月就业报告； ⑤ 21:30 欧洲央行执委Isabel Schnabel讲话； ⑥ 22:00 美国10月密歇根大学消费者信心指数初值； ⑦ 次日04:00 美国波士顿联储主席Collins在一场关于纪念John Leahy的活动上讲话； 微信小程序搜索“见闻历”，了解更多。
text_en: ① South Korean stock market closed all day, Taiwan stock market closed; ② China's January-September aggregate social financing increase, new yuan loans, September M2 and other money supply data may be released; ③ 18:15 ECB Executive Board member Cipollone speaks; ④ 20:30 Canada September employment report; ⑤ 21:30 ECB Executive Board member Isabel Schnabel speaks; ⑥ 22:00 US October University of Michigan consumer sentiment index preliminary reading; ⑦ 04:00 next day Boston Fed President Collins speaks at an event commemorating John Leahy; Search "Jianwenli" on WeChat mini-program for more information.
